name: Curtis Blaydes

official.source: data/derived/fighters.json (76 in height, 80 in reach, orthodox, born 1991-02-18). Weigh-in weight not looked up.

photo_coverage: Good for 2026: 9 of 11 photos are from April to September 2026. Frontal: ESPN studio headshot (Sep 2026) and the Sep 2026 media-day still. Three-quarter: Noche UFC fight photo, April 2026 media still (colour unusable). Profile: clean left profile at the Noche UFC ceremonial weigh-in (Sep 2026). Body: two 2026 studio cutouts and fight photos. No right profile. 2 files (2018 video stills) are CC BY; the rest are reference-only.

face.shape: Large, broad face, rounded-square, widest at the cheeks. The full beard makes the lower face read very wide with a squared-off, rounded bottom.
face.jaw: Wide; hidden by the beard. The beard outline is broad and square.
face.chin: Broad; under the beard. In the left profile the beard carries the chin line forward and down.
face.cheekbones: Broad and full; cheeks full, no hollows.
face.brow_ridge: Prominent and heavy; the brows sit low, with a deep fold above the eyes.
face.forehead: Medium height and broad, with faint horizontal lines. Hairline sharply lined up: straight across the front with crisp angles at the temples.

eyes.shape: Almond, with heavy, hooded upper lids and slight bags below; a calm, heavy-lidded look. Outer corners level to slightly down.
eyes.size: Medium-small, set under the heavy brow.

eyebrows.shape: Straight and low, the outer ends tipping slightly down.

nose.tip: Large, rounded and fleshy, pointing straight ahead.

mouth.upper_lip: Full, with a defined cupid's bow
mouth.lower_lip: Very full; the lower lip is lighter, pinkish-brown in its centre
mouth.resting_expression: Closed, neutral to serious; lips framed by the moustache.

ears.protrusion: Sit fairly close to the head.
ears.cauliflower_ear: Left ear thickened and lumpy in the upper half (cauliflower), clear in the Sep 2026 left profile and in the ESPN frontal; the right ear shows a cleaner rim frontally.

face.notable_marks_scars: No large scars visible; beard and hairline hide much of the lower face.

hair.style: Short, dense coils or small twists on top about 3-4 cm, tapered short on the sides and back with a crisp line-up at the front and temples. Shaved lines: curved part lines at the temples in the 2026 studio photos and a geometric line design on the left side at the Sep 2026 weigh-in.
hair.hairline: Straight, lined up, with sharp temple corners; not receding.

facial_hair.detail: Full, dense beard about 5-7 cm at the chin in the Sep 2026 studio headshot, slightly shorter and rounder at Noche UFC (Sep 12 2026). Moustache joined to the beard. Cheek line trimmed fairly high and straight; full under the jaw.
facial_hair.density: Very dense; skin does not show through.
facial_hair.shape: Broad, rounded-square bottom; volume at the sides and chin; tightly coiled texture.

skin.tone_hex_method: Mean of the 6 samples not marked excluded (9x9-pixel medians). The April 2026 media still was also sampled (#fdb47f cheek) but is overexposed with an orange cast and left out entirely.
skin.tone_note: Medium-deep brown. The neutral ESPN headshot cheeks (#af6b51, #af674a) are the most reliable; the media-day key light lifts the others, so the recommended value sits near the headshot. Between the Leon Edwards (#b76d4d) and Jon Jones (#93593e) sheets.
skin.freckles_marks: Moderate chest hair over the sternum and pecs with some small dark spots in that area; a line of hair down the belly.
skin.texture_pick_reason: Age 35 maps to middleage. Its swatch (#875d4b) is a little darker than the target, so the capped multiply tint will land close to the swatch, slightly deeper than #aa684e; the caucasian base would come out too light after the 30% lerp to white.

body.build: Tall (193 cm), heavy and thick heavyweight with long arms (reach 203 cm).
body.body_fat_notes: Soft, rounded belly with a deep navel and soft flanks; big chest with a soft lower edge; no visible abs.
body.shoulders: Broad and rounded, with full deltoids and thick traps.
body.chest: Large and full, soft lower pecs.
body.arms: Long and thick through the upper arm and forearm.
body.waist: Thick; the torso runs fairly straight from chest to hips.
body.neck: Thick, mostly hidden by the beard.
body.posture: Upright with shoulders rolled slightly forward; gloves held at the hips in studio shots.
body.notable_physique_traits: Full black beard and thick, heavy torso; tribal tattoo on the right shoulder and red-and-black work on the left shoulder.

fight_posture.observed: Noche UFC (Sep 2026): slightly crouched, lead (left) hand extended and open to paw and measure, rear glove at the chin (Getty b); changes levels for takedowns with the head tight to the body (Getty a); wide base in exchanges (Getty c).
fight_posture.confidence: Medium: three action stills from one fight.

tattoos.where: Right shoulder and upper arm (outer deltoid)
tattoos.description: Black tribal design of curved, blade-like bands sweeping from the top of the shoulder down to mid upper arm.

tattoos.where: Top and back of the left shoulder
tattoos.description: Red-filled irregular shape with a dark figure or silhouette over it, outlined in black (subject not identifiable in the photos).

tattoos.where: Left upper arm and forearm, outer and back side
tattoos.description: Long, narrow black-and-grey vertical design running from below the shoulder down onto the forearm (subject not identifiable; clearest at the Sep 2026 weigh-in).

kit.typical_shorts: Noche UFC fight (Sep 12 2026): dark teal-black shorts with a darker pattern and a Noche UFC patch. Sep 2026 studio: dark navy-slate shorts with a grey scalloped pattern, Venum logo and NOCHE UFC patch. Weigh-in: white and grey Venum shorts. April 2026 studio: navy shorts with a grey slash pattern and crypto.com logo.
kit.gloves: Black UFC gloves with blue cuffs at Noche UFC (blue corner).
kit.accessories_seen: Large black smartwatch on the left wrist at the weigh-in (not for the fight).

morphs_not_in_embed._note: assets/embed/mh-manifest.json has no ear targets. Estimates for standard MakeHuman ear modifiers in case they are added; the left ear is the cauliflowered one.

notes: Confidence: high for beard, hair, skin range, tattoos and build; medium for face proportions (sharp frontal and one clean left profile, no right profile); low-to-medium for exact morph values. Watch for: (1) The full, dense black beard defines the lower face; with it the head should read broad and square-bottomed. (2) Heavy brow, hooded dark-brown eyes, a broad nose with a large rounded tip and wide alae, and very full lips. (3) Hair is short and coily with a crisp line-up and shaved lines, not an afro. (4) Tattoo sides are his own: black tribal on the RIGHT shoulder, red-and-black piece on top of the LEFT shoulder, long design down the LEFT arm. (5) Body is heavy with a soft belly; do not give him abs. (6) Skin texture: middleage_african_male lands a touch deep; if it reads too dark, nudge the tint toward #b06d52. macro/ageOldM 0.154 follows avatar3d.js (35-25)/65; heightUpM 0.32 matches the other 193 cm sheets.
